evidence_class: Independent offline archive, Git provenance and read-only GitHub Actions review; no hardware access

publication_receipts.limitation: The operator receipts record the exact-revision live browser and all HTTP byte comparisons. This archive reviewer independently queried workflow completion and rehashed all 543 manifest entries against Git; it did not repeat all live HTTP downloads or the complete browser suite during this archive audit. Counts describe the historical published revision, not later builds.

limitations: Acceptance covers the exact reviewed Nix artifact, eight-window settings and RAM reader in two consecutive bounded minute trials. No general long-run failure rate or corruption-cause claim.
SPECEND totals are validated unprotected text scalars compared to independently CRC-checked frame aggregates, not a protected terminal report.
Nominal sampling, temporal averaging, reception gaps and uncalibrated power remain disclosed; no RF source identity, sensitivity or continuous coverage claim.
RF/calibration, independently counted bursts and FPGA physical gates remain open; AtomVM remains deferred.
Raw RF/flash and unsanitized transcripts remain private; screenshots establish display behavior only.
Publication receipts remain historical proof of18cc even after a newer archive/review deployment.
